verdict.rationale: Runpod offers multiple headless/automation surfaces suitable for CI: an open-source CLI (runpodctl) for scripted resource management, a REST API and GraphQL API for programmatic control, and Serverless SDKs (Python/JS/Go) for automated invocation of endpoints, all designed for integration into 'applications, workflows, and automation systems.' Missing for 10: no explicit CI/CD pipeline example (e.g., GitHub Actions) or independent hands-on report confirming headless CI usage in practice.
